==In the games==
===Core series games===
Dragonite, along with the rest of Ash's team from , was made available in through Pokémon Journeys: The Series broadcasts in Japan. These Pokémon utilize a common password which was revealed during the Japanese TV broadcasts. Players could claim Dragonite with the password , a reference to the species' reputation as "The Sea Incarnate".

==In the manga==
 
===Pokémon Journeys===
Dragonite debuted in Caring for a Mystery!. In Toughing It Out!, it was revealed to have battled Korrina's Lucario in a flashback. In Thrash of the Titans!, Dragonite fought against in a World Coronation Series match.

====Moves used====
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Trivia==
Dragonite is Ash's first:
Non-temporary capture of a species that one of owned first.
Capture of a fully evolved Pokémon as his first new Pokémon in a new series.
Pseudo-legendary Pokémon to be in its fully evolved form.
type to be caught in its fully evolved form.
Capture of a fully evolved Pokémon since in Hook, Line, and Stinker, 927 episodes earlier, and thus also his first such capture outside of the original series.
If temporarily owned Pokémon aren't counted, his last fully evolved capture was in Fowl Play!, 941 episodes earlier.
since Seaking.
His last non-temporary Generation I Pokémon was , which was caught in Snack Attack, 1,001 episodes earlier.
Pokémon to evolve in the same episode it is caught in since in Primeape Goes Bananas, 1,070 episodes earlier.
Capture of a three-stage evolutionary line in its fully evolved form since in The Bug Stops Here, 934 episodes earlier.
If temporary Pokémon aren't counted, it's his first such capture.
Pokémon to be seen evolving prior to its capture since in Dancing With the Ducklett Trio!, 418 episodes earlier.
Capture of a Pokémon that was introduced in a previous generation since in Riding the Winds of Change!, 565 episodes earlier.
Pokémon to know an -boosting status move.
In addition, it is Ash's first Pokémon to know a status move that increases more than one stat at once.
Dragonite is the only pseudo-legendary Pokémon currently in Ash's possession.
Dragonite took part in every on-screen World Coronation Series that advanced Ash to the next rank.
In JN128, the announcer of the World Coronation Series identified Dragonite as (Japanese: 流星の化身 Meteor incarnate) when discussing Ash's team.
Dragonite is referred to as a female in the , , ian, , and dubs.
Although, as revealed by a distribution in the games, Dragonite is female and has the Ability , early promotional materials showed that Dragonite was male and had as an Ability. Said promotional materials have since been updated.
